Namibian nationality law.fact: By the 1760s, Americans were whaling in the coastal waters but within two decades both the British and Dutch had instituted measures to prohibit American vessels from the coastal areas.

Namibian nationality law.fact: The first half of the nineteenth century saw the destabilisation of African communities with territorial disputes arising both internally among chieftainships and with foreigners. Namibian nationality law.subject: Women & Society

Further laws on naturalisation, which did not vary overmuch from the 1817 decree, were passed for the Cape colony in 1856, 1861, and 1868, which were repealed by the consolidation and amendment of 22 August 1883.

Namibian nationality law.fact: Thus, a person who was naturalised in Canada, for example, would be considered a foreigner, rather than a British national, in Australia or South Africa.

Namibian nationality law.fact: Unhappy with German rule, rebellion broke out in 1904.

Namibian nationality law.subject: Women & Society
Namibian nationality law.question: On the first official day of _____ I, a subcommittee of the British Committee of Imperial Defence recommended the seizure of German South West Africa
Namibian nationality law.fact: On the first official day of World War I, a subcommittee of the British Committee of Imperial Defence recommended the seizure of German South West Africa.

Namibian nationality law.subject: Women & Society

Namibian nationality law.fact: On 7 August 1914, the government authorized South Africa to seize South West Africa for Britain in exchange for territory in Luderitzbucht and Swakopmund.

Namibian nationality law.fact: Germany surrendered South West Africa to the British on 9 July 1915 and the territory was occupied by the South African military until the war ended.

Namibian nationality law.subject: Women & Society

Namibian nationality law.fact: Chiefs of the Damaras, Hereros, Nama and Ovambos, protested directly to the British High Commissioner and led a campaign against annexation.

Namibian nationality law.subject: Women & Society

Namibian nationality law.subject: Women & Society
